title: The Curse Following Gulab Rai’s Quarrel at Anandpur

blocks.text: The conflict broadens into an exchange of claims and counter-claims over sacred authority when Gulab Rai’s party confronts saint Gurbakhsh Dass at Anandpur and refuses to yield the place peacefully.

Violence follows when Gulab Rai called his sons to support him, and the page remembers the outrage of tearing off the sacred locks of hair from the Udasi saint as the act that turned rivalry into desecration.

The conclusion is bleak and symmetrical: curse answers curse, and the story says that no one survived from the progeny of both of them, presenting the feud as a warning against false claims to guruship.
